correctness.rationale: Exact conditional counting splits early/early, early/late, late/late crossing pairs with probabilities one-half, one-third, one-third. All finite boundaries and quantifiers checked; complete enumeration through n=7 confirmed the formula. Rayleigh moments follow from the exact Gaussian-tail bound for first closure, and classical Flajolet–Noy crossing variance gives the correlation constant. Enumeration is corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete regression law connects first repeat of a memory game and the crossing-edge statistic of its chord diagram. Its strict monotonicity, exact positive/negative mean comparison and sharp correlation decay reveal a systematic and nontrivial finite-sample dependence not described by existing marginal limit laws.
